It's perfect for those who want to stand out.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Extravagant Saddle is one of several [[Saddle]]s that [[Link]] can obtain. They can be won by beating [[Blynne]]'s record of one minute and fifteen seconds at the [[Obstacle Course]].{{Cite|My best time's {{Color BotW|Red|1 minute 15 seconds}}. Think you can beat that?|Blynne|BotW}}{{Cite|But a man's gotta abide by his word, so here's that {{Color BotW|Red|horse gear}} I promised.|Blynne|BotW}} This type of Saddle is commonly used in festivals. Its delicate embroidery and [[Gem]] arrangements leaves a lasting impression, making it perfect for standing out. The Extravagant Saddle is a piece of [[Extravagant Gear]], which is a set of [[Horse Gear]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} Link can equip the Extravagant Saddle to his [[Horse]]s by speaking to workers at [[Highland Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], or [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Extravagant Saddle}}?|Canni|BotW}} Similar to other Saddles, they are unable to be worn by [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Extravagant Bridle * Extravagant Gear * Horse Gear * Saddle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Horse Gear, Saddles |items= BotW, TotK }}
